cohorts.Title: Large UTF-8 tree / absent literal
cohorts.Distribution: No requested literal occurs in any eligible file.

cohorts.Title: Large UTF-8 tree / sparse literal
cohorts.Distribution: One requested literal occurs in one of every seventeen physical lines.

cohorts.Title: Dense literal matches
cohorts.Distribution: Four non-overlapping requested occurrences occur on every physical line.

warmupPolicy: unwarmed cell has no excluded warmup; post-warmup cell excludes one invocation per candidate
cachePolicy: filesystem cache is not flushed or asserted on this unprivileged Windows host; both phases are labeled unknown rather than cold
timingBoundary: Total Stopwatch surrounds the complete candidate invocation. Managed stage timers attribute traversal, file open/read/decode, matching plus candidate row construction and final output normalization/hash. Ripgrep stage timing attributes process/bridge setup, output collection and JSON normalization; its native traversal/read/matching stages are not observable through the process boundary.

arm64.note: The spike does not cross-compile or emulate ARM64 on an x64 host.

decision.portableRegex: not selected in this literal-only feasibility spike; implementation is owned by W07
decision.reason: The managed literal candidate was measured across no-match, sparse and dense cohorts. Rust was specified and source-prototyped but could not be compiled because rustc/cargo are absent. Ripgrep remains a pinned external baseline, not a production selection; filesystem cache state is unknown and no parity threshold is promoted.
